{
  "dataset_name": "house_8l",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_p3_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed P3 value normalized by training mean and std to create a smooth continuous score suitable for linear margins",
      "value_range": [-0.5, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skewness of P3 distribution, enabling linear SVM to find better separating hyperplanes",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(P3) - np.log1p(2737.4156547183616)) / (np.log1p(2737.4156547183616 + 13818.740327507494) - np.log1p(2737.4156547183616))"
    },
    {
      "name": "p6p4_severity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped and scaled P6p4 value emphasizing deviation from near-zero baseline, capturing tail behavior",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights extreme P6p4 values which may be discriminative for linear SVM boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(P6p4 / 0.891656, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p11p3_centered",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "P11p3 centered around training mean and scaled by std for zero-mean unit-variance approximation",
      "value_range": [-6.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized feature improves SVM margin optimization by equalizing feature scales",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(P11p3 - 0.4847314117044624) / 0.0601735027960949"
    },
    {
      "name": "p16p2_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of P16p2 from its training mean, measuring how far each observation is from typical values",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.75],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures outlier behavior in P16p2 which may correlate with decision boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(P16p2 - 0.716844362253109)"
    },
    {
      "name": "p19p2_h5p2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of P19p2 to H5p2 with smoothing to avoid division by zero, capturing relative magnitude relationship",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio features can capture non-linear interactions in a form usable by linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(P19p2 / (H5p2 + 0.01), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h15p1_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "H15p1 normalized to [0,1] range using observed min and max from training data",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized H15p1 on consistent scale improves SVM convergence and margin quality",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((H15p1 - 0.0) / (9.444444 - 0.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "composite_proportion_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of proportion-type features P11p3, P16p2, and H40p4 as a linear projection",
      "value_range": [0.1, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear combination of correlated proportion features approximates a principal component useful for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.4 * P11p3 + 0.35 * P16p2 + 0.25 * H40p4"
    },
    {
      "name": "p3_log_sqrt_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction between log-transformed P3 and sqrt of P6p4 to capture joint behavior of these two features",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures multiplicative relationship between P3 and P6p4 in a smooth form for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(P3) * np.sqrt(P6p4) / 10.0, 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_p19p2_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Soft indicator for elevated P19p2 values above the mean plus one std, using smooth clipping",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "threshold_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth binary-like signal for high P19p2 regime that linear SVM can use as a feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((P19p2 - 0.05571522267739575) / (0.13842674732094404 + 0.001), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "h40p4_balance_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures how close H40p4 is to 0.5 (balanced midpoint), with higher scores for values near extremes",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures whether H40p4 is near its midpoint or extreme, providing useful signal for linear boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(H40p4 - 0.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "multi_feature_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall feature severity combining P6p4 sparsity, P19p2 elevation, and H5p2 magnitude into a holistic severity score from 0 (low severity) to 1 (high severity)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a semantically meaningful composite severity measure that may align with decision boundaries in ways individual features do not",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "proportion_consistency_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of internal consistency among proportion features P11p3, P16p2, P19p2, and H40p4, scoring 0 for highly inconsistent proportions and 1 for mutually consistent proportion patterns",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures whether proportion features tell a coherent story, which may be a strong signal for linear SVM classification",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
